subject: [PATCH v2 3/3] mm/vmscan: consolidate promo vs. high watermark checks

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch consolidates the pattern of checking the watermark that kswapd reclaims zones up to into a single helper function, reducing code duplication in three different sites. The function, `kswapd_wmark_pages`, takes into account whether NUMA balancing memory tiering is enabled and returns either the promo or high watermark accordingly. This change does not introduce any functional changes but simplifies the code by removing unnecessary includes and consolidating logic.
